LSR College Shifts to Online Classes After Gangrape Near Campus

Lady Shri Ram College (LSR) in Delhi has suspended offline classes and moved to online teaching following an alleged gangrape of a 17-year-old girl in Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. The decision was made due to heightened safety concerns after one of the accused, identified as Asif, was injured in a police encounter near the college's back gate. Two other individuals accused in the incident have also been arrested.
